The company has financial flexibility for a potential operational realignment and cost adjustments.

title: US diesel prices hit a record high, pushing up transportation costs for a long list of goods

This rise in costs is causing transportation fees for everyday goods and services to climb, with businesses now shifting these costs onto consumers via various surcharges. If diesel prices continue on this trajectory, consumers might face even more significant price hikes ahead.
